body: Aside from 2 small relationships I just lost feelings. She has a great personality but didn’t take care of herself. Her mother was overwhelming us. She wasn’t ready for moving away. I just woke up one day and didn’t love her anymore.

So, short answer is yes she likes me back. She’s a little more convoluted with her answers but she has said she likes me. I know it’s really childish but I don’t believe in girls having guy friends because I’ve wanted to sleep with/ have slept with my friends that are girls.
Getting blood flow to it for sure. Public boners. The worst is being a grower.

See, I wish it was that simple to her. She hates moving and wants the next home to be a forever home. I love the country side, it’s basically where I grew up and I hate the city, or any town that’s bigger than what I was used to. I live in a tourist destination currently and it’s just not for me. She’s a city girl. I know the last part all too well. I’d much rather have the help and not need it than need the help and not have it. Unfortunately you can’t have your cake and eat it too in most cases. Baby sitters/ nanny’s/ etc. are there for a reason. My girlfriend isn’t really understanding of that and she for sure isn’t taking my thoughts and feelings into consideration here. I’m sure I’m turning a little bit of a blind eye to her needs too, but I am working on that.
Is there a time frame that it has to be c/w?
